title: CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to an offer to dedicate an easement for sidewalk purposes on 22822 West Ventura…
text:
[Council File 26-1515; CD 3]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to an offer to dedicate an easement for sidewalk purposes on 22822 West Ventura Boulevard - Right of Way No. 36000-10379.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. FIND that the dedication of an easement for sidewalk purposes on 22822 West Ventura Boulevard (Dedication) is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970 pursuant to Article III, Class 5(4) of the City's Environmental Guidelines.
2. ACCEPT the petitioner's offer for the Dedication, substantially as shown on the Exhibit Map of the October 16, 2026 City Engineer report, attached to the Council file.
3. AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works to acquire the Dedication.
4. INSTRUCT the City Clerk to forward a copy of the Council action on this project to the Bureau of Engineering, Survey Division for processing.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that a $3,929 fee for processing this report was paid pursuant to Sections 7.3 and 7.41.1 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
